statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying rhythm disturbances.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) was billed.
Diagnosis codes I49.5, I48.0, and I49.9 were submitted.
The service was denied under reason code CO-22.
The denial was based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating coverage may be provided by another insurer.
